payload.leagueSummary: NET is the whole damn fight right now, and the window says the front of the league is getting sorted by who can keep the ball in play and avoid dumb self-owns. KeithK75 is the cleanest all-around bully in the room, Dan94 is bombing it into the next postcode, and CRANK keeps winning NET despite doing some truly cursed work tee-to-green. Below that, the pack is a mix of guys leaking strokes in different flavors: some can strike it but can’t finish, others are basically manufacturing bogeys at industrial scale.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 owns the best gross profile and still stays near the top in NET, which is what dominance looks like when the swing is actually coherent.
CRANK’s NET results are propped up by short game and putting while the long game goes sideways; that’s a fragile way to live, but it keeps cashing checks for now.
The bottom end is a mess of different diseases: some players are losing it off the tee, some on approach, and some on the greens — and a couple are collecting double bogeys like loyalty points.
